You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0034.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

cat > build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D

rw=Chem.RWMol()
coords={}
def atom(name, elem, charge=0, aromatic=False):
    a=Chem.Atom(elem); a.SetFormalCharge(charge)
    if aromatic: a.SetIsAromatic(True)
    i=rw.AddAtom(a); coords[name]=None
    return i
# atom IDs
names={}
def A(name, elem, charge=0, aromatic=False):
    names[name]=atom(name,elem,charge,aromatic); return names[name]
# indole fused aromatic ring
for n in ['a','b','c','d','e','f']: A(n,'C',aromatic=True)
A('u','C',aromatic=True); A('l','C',aromatic=True); A('ni','N',aromatic=True)
# core
A('k','C'); A('w','C'); A('nq','N',+1); A('x','C'); A('y','C'); A('z','C'); A('q','C'); A('p','C'); A('r','C'); A('s','C'); A('t','C')
# substituents
A('ome','O'); A('memeth','C'); A('meni','C'); A('menq','C')
A('ester','C'); A('ecarbO','O'); A('eoxy','O'); A('ethyl1','C'); A('ethyl2','C')
A('mealk','C')
# explicit stereo Hs as shown
A('hw','H'); A('ht','H'); A('hr','H')
# coordinates in conventional xy (image y reversed)
xy={
'a':(260,-23),'b':(385,-34),'c':(433,-149),'d':(362,-252),'e':(241,-235),'f':(188,-124),
'u':(550,-187),'l':(550,-310),'ni':(433,-354),
'k':(657,-125),'w':(765,-187),'nq':(765,-315),'x':(885,-187),'y':(834,-350),'z':(870,-373),'q':(870,-499),'p':(975,-562),'r':(764,-559),'s':(656,-500),'t':(656,-373),
'ome':(190,-298),'memeth':(100,-340),'meni':(405,-460),'menq':(705,-260),
'ester':(958,-147),'ecarbO':(1030,-97),'eoxy':(1011,-210),'ethyl1':(1090,-240),'ethyl2':(1160,-240),
'mealk':(975,-650), 'hw':(765,-95),'ht':(600,-420),'hr':(764,-650)
}
for n,(xv,yv) in xy.items(): coords[n]=(xv/120.0,yv/120.0)
# add bonds helper
def bond(a,b,bt=Chem.BondType.SINGLE,dir=None):
    rw.AddBond(names[a],names[b],bt)
    if dir:
        rw.GetBondBetweenAtoms(names[a],names[b]).SetBondDir(dir)
# aromatic indole fused ring
for aa,bb in [('a','b'),('b','c'),('c','d'),('d','e'),('e','f'),('f','a'),('c','u'),('u','l'),('l','ni'),('ni','d')]:
    bond(aa,bb,Chem.BondType.AROMATIC)
# methoxy and N methyl
bond('e','ome'); bond('ome','memeth'); bond('ni','meni')
# skeleton
bond('u','k'); bond('k','w'); bond('w','nq'); bond('w','x'); bond('x','y'); bond('y','nq');
bond('nq','t'); bond('t','l'); bond('t','s'); bond('s','r'); bond('r','y'); bond('y','z'); bond('z','q'); bond('q','r'); bond('q','p',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('p','mealk')
# amine methyl wedge
bond('nq','menq',dir=Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)
# ester at x, dashed wedge
bond('x','ester',dir=Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
bond('ester','ecarbO',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('ester','eoxy'); bond('eoxy','ethyl1'); bond('ethyl1','ethyl2')
# explicit H wedge/dashes
bond('w','hw',dir=Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
bond('t','ht',dir=Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
bond('r','hr',dir=Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)

m=rw.GetMol()
# add 2d conformer for bond-direction based stereo parsing
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for n,i in names.items():
    x0,y0=coords[n]
    conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(x0,y0,0.0))
m.AddConformer(conf)
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m,0,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('chiral:')
for n in ['w','x','nq','t','r','y']:
 i=names[n]; a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(i)
 print(n,a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '')
# coordinates conformer currently 2d; preserve chiral tags, remove conf and embed
m.RemoveAllConformers()
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=42; params.useMacrocycleTorsions=True; params.useMacrocycle14config=True
params.enforceChirality=True; params.maxIterations=500
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
print('embed',res)
if res<0:
    raise RuntimeError('embed failed')
# optimize MMFF
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
if props:
    ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,props)
    print('initial energy',ff.CalcEnergy()); ff.Minimize(maxIts=1000); print('final',ff.CalcEnergy())
# recheck assigned stereo after embed
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
for n in ['w','x','nq','t','r','y']:
 a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(names[n]); print('final',n,a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '')
# XYZ
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\nGenerated 3D structure from mol_0034.png\n')
 for a in m.GetAtoms():
  p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
  f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
print('atoms',m.GetNumAtoms(), 'formula',Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
PY
python build.py
ls -l answer.xyz
